description.zh: 三群是平行的資料集合；小圓點為資料，加號大圈為中心。
description.en: Three parallel groups: small dots are data; the large circled plus is a centroid.

en.title: Centroid 1: blue
en.body: Representative position of the upper-left group.

en.title: Centroid 2: orange
en.body: Representative position of the upper-right group.

en.title: Centroid 3: green
en.body: Representative position of the lower group.

note.zh: 虛線圓為教學範圍，不是Voronoi邊界；這不是e-means實驗。
note.en: Dashed circles are teaching regions, not Voronoi boundaries. This is not an e-means experiment.

description.zh: 固定X={1,2,3,8,9,10}，數線保持等距；三角形表示中心。
description.en: Fixed X={1,2,3,8,9,10}; the number line uses equal spacing and triangles mark centroids.

en.title: Before the update
en.body: c₁=2, c₂=8; the left group is 1,2,3 and the right group is 8,9,10.

note.zh: 資料位置不動；右中心從8移到9，左中心維持2。
note.en: Data positions stay fixed; the right centroid moves from 8 to 9 and the left stays at 2.

description.zh: 左右使用相同示意地形；點落在各自谷底。
description.en: Both panels use the same illustrative landscape, with each point at a valley bottom.

zh.title: 左：較淺的局部極小值
zh.body: 每一步下降可能停在這個谷底。

en.title: Left: a shallower local minimum
en.body: A sequence of downhill steps can stop in this valley.

zh.title: 右：較低的局部極小值
zh.body: 另一條最佳化路徑可能到達更低的谷底。

en.title: Right: a lower local minimum
en.body: A different optimization path may reach this lower valley.

note.zh: 這不是實測loss曲線，也不提供全域最優保證。
note.en: This is not a measured loss curve or a guarantee of global optimality.

title.zh: 圖4｜更新頻率與資料遍歷
title.en: Figure 4 | Update frequency and data passes

description.zh: 上下長條代表同一個epoch；下方五批僅為示意。
description.en: Both bars represent one epoch; the five batches below are illustrative.

zh.title: Lloyd：讀完整批再更新
zh.body: 讀完100萬筆，再更新一次中心。

en.title: Lloyd: update after a full pass
en.body: Read all one million points, then update the centroids once.

zh.title: e-means：每批讀完就更新
zh.body: 圖示五個批次，各有一次更新；實際批數由n和B決定。

en.title: e-means: update after each batch
en.body: Five illustrated batches each trigger an update; the actual count depends on n and B.

note.zh: mini-batch改變回饋頻率，不等於每個epoch只讀少量資料。
note.en: Mini-batching changes feedback frequency, not the definition of a full data pass.

description.en: With α=0.20, the positions of 50, 56 and 80 are proportional on the 40–90 number line.

en.title: Gray: old value 50
en.body: Retain 80% of the previous statistic.

en.title: Orange: new value 80
en.body: The new observation receives 20% weight.

note.zh: 這是單一數值的靜態算例；e-means對總和S與計數N做EMA後取比值。
note.en: This is a static scalar example. e-means applies EMA to sums S and counts N, then takes their ratio.

description.zh: 核心是Mini-batch + EMA；下面四項為協同組件，排列沒有先後含義。
description.en: Mini-batch + EMA is the core; the four supporting components are not a sequential pipeline.

zh.title: Cosine Schedule
zh.body: 先積極調整，再逐步穩定。

en.title: Cosine schedule
en.body: Move more actively at first, then stabilize.

zh.title: Dead-cluster Revival
zh.body: 拆分donor群，重新利用低計數中心。

en.title: Dead-cluster revival
en.body: Split a donor cluster to reuse low-count centroids.

zh.title: Finalization
zh.body: 固定保存的指派後，重算最後均值；或選slow EMA。

en.title: Finalization
en.body: Recompute means for saved assignments, or choose slow EMA.

zh.title: Scaling Laws
zh.body: 依n、k、T估計batch size B與初始步長α₀。

en.title: Scaling laws
en.body: Estimate batch size B and initial step α₀ from n, k and T.

note.zh: 各組件的貢獻需消融比較，不能分別宣稱必定加速。
note.en: Use ablations to assess each component; none separately promises a speedup.

description.zh: 橫軸為更新進度u=t/M；縱軸為EMA步長α(u)，不是training loss。
description.en: The horizontal axis is update progress u=t/M; the vertical axis is EMA step α(u), not training loss.

en.title: Endpoint: 100%
en.body: α(1)=0.04, or 10% of the initial value.

note.zh: 依α(u)=0.4[0.1+0.9(1+cos(πu))/2]計算；連續端點與離散索引分開解讀。
note.en: Computed from α(u)=0.4[0.1+0.9(1+cos(πu))/2]; distinguish the continuous endpoint from discrete indexing.

title.zh: 圖8｜離線索引與線上查詢

description.zh: 離線先訓練中心並建立平行區域；線上查詢選候選區域後搜尋。
description.en: Train centroids and create parallel regions offline; choose candidate regions and search them at query time.

en.title: Offline: 10 million document vectors
en.body: Documents become embeddings → k-means/e-means trains centroids.

zh.title: 平行區域A、B、C
zh.body: 各區存放指派到該中心的資料，A/B/C沒有先後順序。

en.title: Parallel regions A, B and C
en.body: Each region holds assigned data; A/B/C are peers, not sequential stages.

zh.title: 線上：查詢向量
zh.body: 查詢向量 → 選擇相關候選區域 → 搜尋候選文件。

en.title: Online: query vector
en.body: Query vector → choose relevant candidate regions → search candidate documents.

note.zh: IVF概念示意；低MSE不必然提高Recall@10，也不直接加速LLM生成。
note.en: IVF concept sketch: lower MSE does not necessarily improve Recall@10 or directly speed up LLM generation.
